command: bash -lc grep\ -E\ \'\^\(processor\|model\ name\|microcode\|cpu\ MHz\|cache\ size\|physical\ id\|core\ id\|siblings\|cpu\ cores\)\'\ /proc/cpuinfo
bash -lc for\ z\ in\ /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone\*\;\ do\ echo\ \'###\'\ \$z\;\ grep\ -H\ .\ \$z/type\ \$z/temp\ \$z/trip_point_\*\ 2\>/dev/null\;\ done
bash -lc for\ c\ in\ /sys/class/thermal/cooling_device\*\;\ do\ echo\ \'###\'\ \$c\;\ grep\ -H\ .\ \$c/type\ \$c/cur_state\ \$c/max_state\ 2\>/dev/null\;\ done
bash -lc for\ h\ in\ /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon\*\;\ do\ echo\ \'###\'\ \$h\;\ grep\ -H\ .\ \$h/name\ \$h/\*_label\ \$h/temp\*_input\ \$h/fan\*_input\ \$h/pwm\*\ 2\>/dev/null\;\ done
bash -lc for\ d\ in\ \$\(upower\ -e\)\;\ do\ echo\ \'###\'\ \$d\;\ upower\ -i\ \$d\;\ done
